title: Canonical finite point tensor normalization on K-flat representatives
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $p,a,k=\overline{\mathbf F}_{p^a}$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ as in [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Use its recorded point fibre functors, the finite-Tor subcategories of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and the finite, completed integral, rational, and common-stage derived tensors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For comparison data of [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-system], define finite canonicality by requiring, for every pair of K-flat sheaf complexes whose derived images are finite-Tor constructible, that the comparison, conjugated by the recorded K-flat tensor model and exact-sections localization comparisons, is the chain isomorphism sending a total-tensor section generator $x\otimes y$ to the total-tensor generator of their final-object sections.
